there exists a strong positive correlation between macro economic variables, such as inflation, and the price of Bonds and Equity.
the mathematical model which best depicts the relationship between asset pricing and macro economic variables is the Ornstein Uhlenbeck Process.
the best model to describe the volatility of the Sri Lankan stock market is a mean reverting stochastic process, which is the Ornstein Uhlenbeck process.

the development of an optimum mathematical model which accurately depicts the impact of macroeconomic variables on the volatility in the pricing of Bonds and Equities, which in turn is used in the calculation of Solvency metrics.
the derivation of an accurate model for the stochastic process of asset pricing in the context of Solvency forecasting.
the development of a model which can accurately forecast the effect of macro economic factors on asset prices, and therefore, on solvency.
